newsitem.title: USA: Gannett division buys printing company.
newsitem.headline: Gannett division buys printing company.

text.p: News and information company Gannett Co Inc said Monday one of its divisions had bought a printing company for an undisclosed sum.
The company said its commercial printing division, Gannett Offset, had acquired Printed Media Cos of Minneapolis to complement its cold web and direct marketing services group.
Printed Media is a full-service heat set printer with seven web presses and pre- and post-press production capabilities, it said.
"The acquisition of PMC is a perfect fit with our current operations," it said.
Gannett said the acquisition brought the total number of printing plants in Gannett Offset to nine.

"The division now includes seven cold web and two heat set printing plants, a direct marketing services group which includes Gannett Telemarketing, Gannett Direct Marketing and Telematch, a computer and data base marketing company," it said.
